SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Am. br.]
Pterygium.
In morning eyes red and sore, with white mucus in corners, < left eye. θ Ophthalmia scrofulosa.
Scrofulous ophthalmia.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Am. br.]
An old hemorrhoidal tumor returned quite hard, sore and small, but soon left.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Am. br.]
Dull constant pain and hard swelling in left ovary.
Ovarian neuralgia.
Uterine hemorrhage from ovarian irritation or inflammation.
   

COUGH. [27] [Am. br.]
Sudden desire to cough coming so suddenly it strangles one. θ Pertussis.
   

TIME. [38] [Am. br.]
Morning : eyes red and sore ; tongue dry ; tongue smarts ; mouth dry ; mouth as if burnt and full of mucus, also throat ; tickling in throat ; short cough on rising.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Am. br.]
Obesity.
